description: This entry represents the 74D Waterways sheet of Alberta’s Provincial Access/Topographic Map Series, a 50-sheet colour map series at 1:250,000 scale. The native Alberta source ID and explicit Canadian mirror establish the sheet identity. The source identifies major roads, railways, municipalities, hydrography, the Alberta Township System, selected administrative features and contours at 50 m intervals. Waterways is the sheet name; the description does not establish inland-waterway operation or lock data. Native time-span fields say 2006, without a precise survey date. The current CUDC resource descriptors point to HTML/XML metadata pages. Earlier Canadian metadata listed PDF as well; no PDF body has been checked. The mapped road and rail assets establish infrastructure scope. Coordinate reference system, numerical accuracy and current operating status are unspecified. Geographic coverage is within Alberta. Related map components retain their native catalogue identities. The native packages list Open Government Licence - Alberta and unrestricted access, but isopen is false. Actual file access and any cost are unverified. Distribution metadata mainly points to HTML/XML descriptive pages; these are not machine-readable infrastructure geometries. No map, PDF, image, archive or dataset body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are not stated.
